name: Amethyst
overview: Scripture identifies amethyst as a precious stone of notable significance, featured prominently in the high priest's breastplate as recorded in Exodus 28:19 and Exodus 39:12, symbolizing its valued place in the worship of God. Additionally, Revelation 21:20 includes amethyst among the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem, underscoring its enduring spiritual symbolism and beauty in the eternal kingdom. These references highlight amethyst's role as a symbol of divine glory and holiness within God's redemptive plan.
